meta.note: Static, rule-based lookup table: what a real, currently-active certification's official exam objectives actually cover, applied so a matched credential can mark specific related corpus items as satisfied even if their literal keyword never appears on the CV. Deliberately conservative — pairs are only included where the certifying body's own domain/module structure names the topic directly, not merely 'could come up.' Compiled from a research pass over each cert's official exam objectives/blueprint (CompTIA, EC-Council, ISC2, INE, OffSec) plus reputable secondary sources that cite those objectives directly; sources are cited per credential below.
meta.appliesAcrossCategories: Implied items can land in concepts_frameworks, tools, or scripting_programming — not just networking concepts — since that's what the certifications actually certify.
meta.excludedDeliberately: Plausible-but-unconfirmed pairs were left out rather than guessed, e.g. Active Directory for CEH/CySA+/ISC2 CC/Network+, OWASP Top 10 for eJPT/OSCP, Nessus/Kali Linux for CEH, Bash/Shell for CySA+, SIEM/ISO 27001 for ISC2 CC/Network+/CCNA.
